name: get_consultation
description: Read what the user told you in their consultation: routine, diet, likes, dislikes, allergies, challenges, health notes. Use it before you build or rebuild their plan.

name: save_plan
description: Save the user's weekly plan in the app, the whole week at once. Use it when you have built a new plan (after the app reports consultation_finished) or rebuilt it because the user asked. For one change, use swap_item instead.

title.description: The week's title, e.g. 'A steady start, built for consistency'.

items.description: The day's meals and actions, in time order.

title.description: What it is, e.g. 'Vegetable oats with paneer'.

details.description: One line: portion or how to do it.

why.description: One short sentence on why it fits their goal.

name: get_plan
description: Read the user's saved plan: one day, or the whole week when no day is given. Use it before answering any question about their plan; never guess what is on it.

day.description: The day; leave it out for the whole week.

name: swap_item
description: Change one item of the user's plan when they ask, or when what they tell you means it will not work (an ingredient they do not have, a meal they cannot make). Tell them what changed.

time.description: The item's time, as on the plan, e.g. 09:30.

details.description: One line: portion or how to do it.

reason.description: Why it changed, in a few words.

name: log_check_in
description: Record how the user did with an item of their plan when they tell you, for example after a meal check-in.

time.description: The item's time, as on the plan.

note.description: What they said, in a few words.
